## GI and respiratory product summary

- Total GI Comprehensive Stool Profile:
  - 68 PCR targets
  - Bacterial and fungal culture with antibiotic and natural agent sensitivity
  - Total Parasites via Microscopy (Gold Standard)
  - Functional markers including calprotectin, pancreatic elastase, secretory IgA, zonulin, anti-gliadin IgA, stool fat, stool carbohydrate, and H. pylori antigen
  - Single stool collection
- EGHA Essential Gut Health Assessment:
  - Focused PCR + culture + ova and parasite microscopy
  - Core intestinal marker panel
- Upper Respiratory Micro Screen:
  - Bacterial and fungal culture
  - MARCoNS culture evaluation
  - Group A strep ID
  - Susceptibility on positive bacterial cultures
